disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (SPEC Decisions: Java/Kotlin compile-time constants): a static final (or interface) field of primitive/String type with a constant initializer, and a Kotlin const val, is inlined by the compiler and gets no implicit <clinit> edge
note: Every removed edge checked by constcheck.py against its declaration (static && final|interface, constant type, constant expression). Tests: java constant_fields_contract_test.go CompileTimeConstantsHaveNoImplicitEdge, kotlin const_val_contract_test.go ConstValHasNoImplicitEdge.

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (same decision): an interface field is implicitly static final; a non-constant one (e.g. FailablePredicate FALSE = t -> false) is initialized in <clinit> and gets the implicit edge, as a class's static field does
note: commons-lang function/ interfaces (43 edges): constant_declaration is now registered as a defined member and caller.

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (same decision): a call in an interface field initializer is the field's, reached from <clinit> through the implicit edge
note: FailableConsumer NOP = Function.identity()::apply: <clinit> → FailableConsumer#NOP (implicit) and NOP → Function#identity (method, medium).

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (same decision): an interface field initializer's call is the field's
note: s-orc TestConf (interface) Configuration conf = getNewConf(): <clinit> → TestConf#conf (implicit), TestConf#conf → TestConf#getNewConf (method).

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (SPEC Decisions: Groovy def locals): a def local bound once to a call with a declared return type takes that type; an out-of-scan type's member is medium
note: def applicationContext = initializer.configure() (ApplicationContext), def keyToolClass = getKeyToolClass() (Class). Reassigned locals and Object/def/void/generic returns stay untyped (low). Test: groovy letbound_def_contract_test.go DefLocalBoundToTypedCall.

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (SPEC Decisions: Groovy def locals): an in-scan type's member is high
ruling 2026-11-16 (SPEC Decisions: Rust smart pointers): a crate impl for the pointer itself (impl<T: LogStore + ?Sized> LogStore for Arc<T>) is the callee before the deref
note: Arc<dyn LogStore>.object_store() resolves to Arc#object_store. Test: rust pointer_impl_contract_test.go CrateImplForArcWinsWhenBoundHolds.

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (same decision): ?Sized is not a bound, so T: LogStore + ?Sized is bounded by LogStore
note: logstore/mod.rs (15): self.m() inside impl<T: LogStore + ?Sized> LogStore for Arc<T> is LogStore#m.

disposition: ruling 2026-11-16 (same decision): a T receiver bounded by a trait now names the bound's or the pointer's member rather than T
note: session.rs T: Session → Session#runtime_env; engine_ext.rs → ArrowEngineData#try_from_engine_data; mod.rs → Arc#new. Out-of-scan bounds stay medium.
